title: Amar
overview: A romantic drama inspired by certain real life incidents from the 1990s, the film follows the story of two youngsters who meet and fall in love during a bike rally. Directed by Nagshekar, Amar stars Abhishek Ambareesh and Tanya Hope in the lead roles
